ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.4.19-JR1.1 Learned BFS is the performance-first correction to JR1 Aggressive. JD1 AutoTrace identified ClosestThingReachable and RegionTraverser.BreadthFirstTraverse as the dominant JobGiver spike source. JR1's cold-path implementation could perform an extra full Region traversal before candidate scanning, and its global Region.Allows Harmony detour added overhead to an extremely hot method. JR1.1 removes both costs. The first Regionwise search for a traversal shape executes Vanilla once while RimMT records the actual Region BFS order in-flight; repeated traversal shapes in the same JobPackage reuse that order and skip RegionTraverser while still scanning live candidates and running live WorkGiver validators. Destination Region permission and forbidden-region checks are reused only inside this hot Regionwise path; there is no global Region.Allows detour. JS1.2.1 Lean Hybrid HasJobOnThing and nearest-order behavior remains. ReachProfile rolling safety is also reimplemented without self-patching AggressiveReachabilityProfiles methods: the lifetime 16-mismatch fuse is intercepted, 8192/8 rolling density triggers a 3600-frame live cooldown, 256 clean native shadow samples recover normal mode, and 16/256 remains the emergency hard fuse. RegionHint remains retired. This is an aggressive performance playtest build; compatibility issues are fixed from runtime evidence.
